parsed.production_notes: The video features a human recording of hands interacting with physical printed papers on a desk. However, the illustrations on the printed papers appear to be AI-generated, exhibiting typical flat vector styles or uncanny details like the robot teacher.

characters.appearance: Only hands and forearms are visible. Brown skin tone, average build.

scenes.setting: Plain white desk surface, bright even lighting.

panels.panel_visual_description: Top-down view of a plain white surface. Character A's hands, holding a green marker, are visible interacting with printed papers. The first paper shows an illustration of a red apple and a colorful beach ball. Character A draws green arrows and checkmarks next to the illustrations. The paper is then swapped for another showing a young girl writing at a desk and a sad woman with crossed arms below her. Character A draws more green checkmarks on this second paper. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows from the hands.
